title: Between bamboo and breaking point
description: Outside the gates of Kanhouli Leprosy Mission Hospital in Muzaffarpur, on a narrow strip of land squeezed between the road and the pavement, stands a small hut patched together with bamboo and tarpaulin. This is where Soni Kumari lives. Inside her home, bamboo is everywhere.
